findings.summary: Pending Slack link intents can be consumed after the Maestro user loses authorization
findings.details: consumeSlackIdentityLink is an internal mutation that activates a pending binding by nonce after checking only pending status, expiry, team match, duplicate active Slack identity, and current connection generation. It does not re-resolve the pending row's user/workosSubject against active user status, organization membership, or workspace membership before activation. A user can create a pending intent while authorized, then be suspended or removed from the Brain before Slack confirmation, and the stale nonce can still become an active Slack identity binding. This violates the S10-T01 requirement to revoke on user/membership suspension and to recheck current Brain role for Slack identity use; it also leaves a durable active exact Slack identity for a no-longer-authorized Maestro user.
